sql.value: SELECT account_sets_id, id, adjustments, auxiliary_accounting, balance_direction, code, currency_accounting, full_name, IF((select count(1) from fxy_financial_subject as ffs2 where ffs2.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffs2.status = 1 and ffs2.parent_id = ffs.id) > 0, 0, 1) as leaf, level, mnemonic_code, name, parent_id, query_code, status, system_default, type, unit, cash, non_auxiliary_accounting FROM fxy_financial_subject AS ffs WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId AND ffs.status = 1 #[@if(:isLocal==false) AND json_contains(ffs.currency_accounting, :currencyId)] #[AND ffs.type = :type] order by ffs.query_code, ffs.id

SELECT account_sets_id, id, adjustments, auxiliary_accounting, balance_direction, code, currency_accounting, full_name, IF((select count(1) from fxy_financial_subject as ffs2 where ffs2.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffs2.status = 1 and ffs2.parent_id = ffs.id) > 0, 0, 1) as leaf, level, mnemonic_code, name, parent_id, query_code, status, system_default, type, unit, cash, non_auxiliary_accounting FROM fxy_financial_subject AS ffs WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId AND ffs.status = 1 #[AND ffs.type = :type] order by ffs.query_code, ffs.id
